date_scope_check.qualification: SA027-REV1: The May 2020 bounds represent the affected Nathu La/Sherethang trading season, not the March policy announcement or an exact first lost trading day. August 1, 2026 is the formal reopening; the August 1 EastMojo report scheduled first trade for August 3. A September 11 PIB report quotes the customs commissioner confirming resumed trade and describes the regulated Monday–Thursday, registered-trader regime. This strengthens confirmation that reopening proceeded, but does not independently establish the exact first commercial crossing. The policy span includes routine winter and weekly closures and cannot be read as operational closure-days. It applies only to Nathu La/Sherethang. Separately, the August 2 Times of India report records 16 traders and four staff crossing Lipulekh on August 1 without goods. Shipki La traders were flagged off on August 1; independently observed arrival or first transaction is not established by that report. These distinct movements do not establish general passenger access at all three passes.
